study type: Secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study
exposure: Induction method (prostaglandins alone, prostaglandins plus mechanical ripening, oxytocin only)
cohort: 270 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by oligohydramnios, induced at a tertiary-care hospital between 2002 and 2013
finding: In patients with fetuses with oligohydramnios with and without FGR, most patients delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery regardless of induction method.
